```{r}
## Waffle chart of pill icons: 5 x 20 grid, 3.7% filled
# Requires: ggplot2   (install.packages("ggplot2"))

library(ggplot2)

# ---- Settings ---------------------------------------------------------------
pct <- 56                # percent to fill (each pill = 1%)
rows  <- 5
cols  <- 20
blue  <- "#2C5080"          # UNC Carolina blue
gray  <- "#D9DEE3"
L     <- 0.78               # pill length
W     <- 0.36               # pill width
angle <- 45 * pi / 180      # pill tilt
caption1 <- "Each pill = 1% of the sample"
caption2 <- "Source: Synthea Massachusetts, random sample of 111 patients"
out_file <- "waffle_chart_pills.png"

# ---- Shape helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
# Capsule outline (u along the pill's length, v across), centered on (0, 0)
capsule_uv <- function(n = 60) {
  hs <- L / 2 - W / 2                      # half-length of the straight section
  t1 <- seq(-pi / 2,     pi / 2,     length.out = n)   # right cap
  t2 <- seq( pi / 2, 3 * pi / 2,     length.out = n)   # left cap
  data.frame(u = c( hs + W / 2 * cos(t1), -hs + W / 2 * cos(t2)),
             v = c(      W / 2 * sin(t1),       W / 2 * sin(t2)))
}

# Thin seam across the middle of the pill
seam_uv <- data.frame(u = c(-0.02, 0.02, 0.02, -0.02),
                      v = c(-W / 2, -W / 2, W / 2, W / 2))

# Rotate by `angle`, move to (cx, cy), and optionally cut off everything right
# of clip_x (used for the partly filled pill)
place <- function(uv, cx, cy, id, clip_x = Inf) {
  data.frame(
    x  = pmin(cx + uv$u * cos(angle) - uv$v * sin(angle), clip_x),
    y  = cy + uv$u * sin(angle) + uv$v * cos(angle),
    id = id
  )
}

# ---- Grid layout total coverage ------------------------------------------------------------
idx  <- 0:(rows * cols - 1)
r    <- idx %/% cols
c    <- idx %% cols
cx   <- c + 0.5
cy   <- rows - 1 - r + 0.5                 # first row at the top
fill <- pct - idx                          # >= 1 full, between 0 and 1 partial

body <- capsule_uv()

build <- function(uv, keep, clip) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(which(keep), function(i)
    place(uv, cx[i], cy[i], id = i, clip_x = clip[i])))
}

all_i <- rep(TRUE, length(idx))
blue_i <- fill > 0
# Partial pill is cut at the matching fraction of the pill's width
clip_x <- ifelse(fill >= 1, Inf, (cx - 0.38) + 0.76 * fill)

gray_body <- build(body,   all_i,  rep(Inf, length(idx)))
gray_seam <- build(seam_uv, all_i, rep(Inf, length(idx)))
blue_body <- build(body,   blue_i, clip_x)
blue_seam <- build(seam_uv, blue_i, clip_x)

# ---- Plot -------------------------------------------------------------------
total_coverage_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = gray_body, aes(x, y, group = id), fill = gray) +
  geom_polygon(data = gray_seam, aes(x, y, group = id), fill = "white") +
  geom_polygon(data = blue_body, aes(x, y, group = id), fill = blue) +
  geom_polygon(data = blue_seam, aes(x, y, group = id), fill = "white") +
  annotate("text", x = cols / 2, y = -0.55, label = caption1,
           size = 15 / .pt, colour = "#555555") +
  annotate("text", x = cols / 2, y = -1.05, label = caption2,
           size = 12 / .pt, colour = "#777777") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, cols), ylim = c(-1.35, rows + 0.15), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

# 10.5 in wide, height follows the grid's aspect ratio (6.5 units tall / 20 wide)
ggsave(out_file, total_coverage_plot, width = 10.5, height = 10.5 * 6.5 / cols,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
total_coverage_plot
```
